notes.claim: Matrix methods turn the loop equations of a circuit into one equation, [V] = [R] x [I], that a solver can handle together.

sources.quote: By breaking down a complicated system into simple loops, Kirchhoff’s law can be applied. This leads to a set of linear equations in the unknown quantities (usually currents)

sources.title: Mesh Current Analysis - DC Circuit Theory
sources.quote: Write the matrix or vector equation [V] = [R] x [I]. Where [I] is the list of currents to be found.
